title: Fix non-integer PLACE rule values breaking scale inference
description:
## Summary
- Normalize DuckDB DECIMAL Arrow columns to Float64 in `CallbackReader`
- Fixes fractional `PLACE rule` positions (e.g. `x => 21.5`) incorrectly flipping position scales to discrete or breaking histogram binning
- Add SQL logic test coverage for point + histogram cases from #13

Fixes #13

## Test plan
- [x] `GGSQL_NO_OPEN_BROWSER=1 make test`
- [x] Manual verification of point + histogram queries with non-integer PLACE rule values

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

title: Propagate caller interruptions to ggsql inner queries
description:
Forward the outer context interrupt flag while the sibling connection is active, check cancellation between SQL calls and Arrow batches, and restore DuckDB interruption errors after releasing the Rust result buffer. Join the forwarder before destroying its connection.

Add embedded regression coverage for both entry points, repeated cancellation and connection reuse, single- and multi-threaded execution, and unrelated connection isolation. Run the Python tests against the distribution artifact in CI.

title: Begin migration to DuckDB 2.0 alpha and upgrade ggsql to 0.5.2
description: Pin DuckDB and extension CI tooling, adapt parser and execution APIs, and refresh the bundled Vega renderers. Add parser and embedding regression coverage, update CI, and document compatibility limitations and validation.
